services company. We help enterprises move from fragmented data to trusted enterprise
context, and from AI pilots to measurable, production-ready AI outcomes. Our work spans
four service pillars: Advisory Services, Enterprise Architecture, Data Foundations, and AI
and Intelligent Systems, delivered across regulated, data-intensive, and operationally
complex industries globally.

Hyderabad. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role responsible for running multiple
concurrent client engagements across geographies and industries, ensuring delivery
quality, margin, client satisfaction, and repeatable delivery excellence across all four
Context66 service pillars.

management of staffing, pods, program governance, quality assurance, escalation
resolution, and delivery-to-revenue accountability. This leader will partner closely with the
CEO, CTO, practice leads, and account teams to successfully transform closed
engagements into referenceable client outcomes.

Enterprise Architecture, Data Foundations, and AI and Intelligent Systems

AI Economics and TCO/ROI Dashboard

talent

● 15 years in technology services delivery, consulting delivery leadership, or
program/portfolio management, with at least 5 years in a senior delivery leadership
role VP, Director of Delivery, or equivalent)

transformation engagements at enterprise scale
● Experience managing a multi-account, multi-industry delivery portfolio
simultaneously
● Experience leading distributed, multi-geography delivery teams India, and ideally
Romania, Colombia, or Mexico)
● Strong track record of client executive relationship management at CIO/CTO/CDO
level
● Experience in a high-growth or startup-like services environment preferred

management, margin and utilization management

Location: Primary: Hyderabad, India. Other locations: Rest of India, Romania, Colombia, and Mexico

About Context66
Context66 is a Data, AI, and Enterprise Architecture services company focused on engineering the context that powers AI.

We help enterprises transform fragmented data, systems, documents, and business knowledge into trusted, governed, reusable, and AI-ready enterprise context. Our work spans modern data foundations, enterprise data architecture, integration, semantic layers, knowledge graphs, GraphRAG, ontologies, metadata, intelligent automation, and production-grade AI systems.
